blocks.text: KUALA LUMPUR – Malaysian police are investigating a 54-year-old Filipino former pilot with a drug-related criminal record in the Philippines and a 51-year-old Filipino woman over their alleged links to a syndicate connected to a 52-kilogram drug seizure in Laos. Bukit Aman Narcotics Crime Investigation Department (NCID) director Hussein Omar Khan said investigators had recorded statements from several people, including a Malaysian national suspected of acting as a broker who arranged the rental of the aircraft involved in the seizure at Luang Prabang International Airport. “The individual disclosed that the aircraft had been rented by a 54-year-old Filipino man, identified as […]...
